1. 야고보서 기록 배경\n - 저자는 예수님의 동생 야고보\n - 야고:
1. Background of James
 - The author is James, the brother of Jesus
 - One common misunderstanding of James is that it stresses 'works only'. But James isn't talking about works; he's talking about faith. And that faith is a faith that has works. Faith and works aren't opposite ideas. Works and faith go together like parallel lines. In other words, a person's works are the evidence that the person has faith.
2. 야고보가 말하는 믿음\n 1) 시험과 시련을 이기는 믿음\n - 우:
2. The faith James talks about
 1) Faith that overcomes trials and testing
 - When we have true faith, true trials come. Satan isn't stupid either. He doesn't bother wasting effort on someone who's headed to hell anyway. But when that person struggles hard to live by faith, he won't leave them alone.
또 하나님께서도 테스트를 하신다. 테스트도 있고 시련도 있는 것. 테스:
And God tests us too. There's testing and there's trial. Testing is checking you out, and trial is refining you. You have to pass through all of these.
 2) Faith that has works
 - These works mean love. Faith that puts love into practice. Faith without love is nothing but self-hypnosis.
 3) Faith that bears fruit through patience
 - Right now is exactly the time when patience is desperately needed. It's a virtue stressed all the more as the day of the Lord's coming draws near, because the trials are going to get more intense.
 4) Faith full of good fruit
 - Love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
 - Only when these fruits of the Spirit show up in what we do can we say there's faith.
 5) Faith without partiality or hypocrisy
 - Our faith must not lean to the left or to the right; it must be without partiality.
 6) Faith that isn't friends with the world
<약4:4~5> 간음하는 여자들이여 세상과 벗된 것이 하나님의 원수임을:
<Jas 4:4~5> You adulterers and adulteresses, don't you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God. Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously"?
 - Being friends with the world is being God's enemy. We live in the world, but we must not become friends with the world.
 7) Faith that has love and mercy
<약2:13> 긍휼을 행하지 아니하는 자에게는 긍휼 없는 심판이 있으리라: <Jas 2:13> For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
이제 마지막 책 요한계시록을 보기 바로 직전인데 마지막 때를 살펴 보게: Now we're right before the last book, Revelation, where we'll look at the end times. Before that, there's something to take care of: we're going to sort out faith, hope, and love.
야고보는 행함이 있는 참 믿음: James: true faith that has works
베드로는 하나님의 약속에 근거한 참 소망: Peter: true hope grounded in God's promise
요한은 진리 안에서 참 사랑: John: true love in the truth
